user_requirement: Manny 和 Quinn 两款人偶分别保持与对应 UE 角色一致的体格比例，摆姿势尽量所见即所得。
stature_definition: Neutral sole surface to crown surface, excluding fixed stand and protruding electronics.
policies: Choose joint centres before packing hardware.
Do not independently lengthen limbs or widen shoulders to fit components.
Use global scale or mechanism redesign when components do not fit.
Include moving multi-axis pivot offsets in kinematics, not only reference-pose link lengths.
Compare actual mapped Manny endpoint positions and contact surfaces; visual pose names alone are not acceptance.
Keep 44 axis IDs and existing virtual profile unchanged; export a new physical profile.
Quinn must use her own mesh reference lengths, never Manny lengths copied from the shared Control Rig.
